flags.reason: The Product Merchandising Card guide (3f56271) and its evidence were checked on 20 October 2026 on the c7d3348 build; the installed v0.1.78-dbe0e02 has a different ProductMerchandisingCard.tsx (9e4e6ac at c7d3348, 660c1b0 at dbe0e02), changed by Biscuit's ace46ca and dbe0e02 for Component Bug #356, and the evidence's 28 October note says the guide's copy waits for #356's own publish. Read against the installed source, these sentences no longer hold, and the entry leaves them out: (1) Anatomy's Footer note “A blurred copy of the photo behind the text; no dark shade.”: a 65 px gradient from transparent to black now sits over the blur (ProductMerchandisingCard.tsx lines 331–399). (2) Configuration's “badge, avatar, specialBadge, and cta replace those parts and don’t get the card’s modes.” and the Badge icons caption “An Icon before each label; the card doesn’t colour it.”: the slots are cloned with the card's modes (45–58, 235–297), and a default Icon in badgeIcon is purple, rgb(93, 0, 181), and white in specialBadgeIcon. (3) The Badge Size Small caption “Smaller badges.”: the glass badge is pinned to Badge Size Medium (224–233, 505–513), so only the corner badge gets smaller. (4) Do & Don'ts: “White text needs a photo behind it.” and “The card has no background, so its white title disappears.”: without imageSource the card draws a #141414 surface (318–324, 377–379); “A stranger’s stock photo appears.”: without avatarSource the avatar is a monogram of avatarMonogram or else the title's first letter (248–262), and the page rendered on this build already shows “S” in that Don't; and the description's “loses its text, shows a stranger”. (5) Sources: “… and has no gradient”, “Figma darkens the footer with a black gradient, while the package draws only a blurred copy of the photo, so the white text sits on a pale haze, with a lighter band where the copy is re-cropped.”, “Badge icons and the badge, avatar, specialBadge, and cta slots don’t get the card’s modes.” and “Without avatarSource or avatarMonogram the avatar is a stock portrait, and without imageSource the card has no background.” The guide is updated when Component Bug #356 publishes (the Component Fix flow updates the guide copy a fix changed; the sentences are listed in a note on #356), then a new Agent pack ticket re-extracts. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r25, for Marcin to confirm. Component Bug #356.

examples.purpose: The offer on the Home screen, the guide’s In context: a Title heading over one card with a photo, an avatar, both badges and the Open Button. The URIs stand for the offer’s photo and the brand’s logo, and onCtaPress for the screen starting its own sign-up. The accessibilityLabel is the one the guide’s code gives the card (the rendered copy doesn’t show it).
examples.jsx:
<VStack>
  <Title title="For you" subtitle="Offers picked for your savings" />
  <ProductMerchandisingCard
    imageSource={{ uri: 'https://example.com/savings-account-photo.png' }}
    avatarSource={{ uri: 'https://example.com/jio-gold-logo.png' }}
    badgeLabel="New"
    specialBadgeLabel="Zero balance"
    title="Savings account"
    subtitle="Open in 5 minutes"
    ctaLabel="Open"
    onCtaPress={() => {}}
    accessibilityLabel="Savings account, zero balance, open in 5 minutes"
  />
</VStack>

from.quote: Open starts the screen’s own sign-up through onCtaPress; the card only shows the offer.

props.name: imageSource
props.description: Background media for the card. Accepts a URL string or any RN `ImageSourcePropType` (same shape as `Avatar`, `MediaCard`, etc.). The image is rendered full-bleed behind the header and glass footer.

props.name: title
props.description: Footer title (bold, white). Default "Title", from the component source.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Footer subtitle (muted). Default "Subtitle", from the component source.

props.name: badgeLabel
props.description: Header badge label (top-right). The badge is hidden when this is `undefined` and no `badge` override is provided.

props.name: badgeIcon
props.description: Optional leading node (icon/image) rendered before the header badge label, inside the badge surface. Maps to `Badge`'s `leading` slot — the same pattern as `specialBadgeIcon` for the footer badge. Ignored when a full `badge` override is supplied. Receives the lilac-badge modes so a default `Icon` is purple.

props.name: badge
props.description: Full override for the header badge. Takes precedence over `badgeLabel`. `null`, `false` and `''` hide the badge (same as omitting `badgeLabel`).

props.name: showAvatar
props.description: Show the header avatar (top-left). Defaults to `true`. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: avatarSource
props.description: Avatar image source.

props.name: avatarMonogram
props.description: Avatar monogram fallback when no image is supplied.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Full override for the header avatar. Takes precedence over avatar props. `null`, `false` and `''` hide the avatar.

props.name: specialBadgeLabel
props.description: Footer "special badge" label (small frosted pill above the title). The badge is hidden when this is `undefined` and no `specialBadge` override is provided.

props.name: specialBadgeIcon
props.description: Optional leading node (icon/image) rendered inside the special badge.

props.name: specialBadge
props.description: Full override for the special badge. Takes precedence over the props above. `null`, `false` and `''` hide the pill.

props.name: ctaLabel
props.description: CTA button label. Defaults to `"CTA"`. Default "CTA", from the component source.

props.name: onCtaPress
props.description: CTA button press handler.

props.name: cta
props.description: Full override for the CTA. Takes precedence over `ctaLabel`/`onCtaPress`. `null`, `false` and `''` hide the button.

props.name: onPress
props.description: With onPress the card is a Pressable with role button, named accessibilityLabel or else the title, at 0.92 opacity while pressed; the Button keeps its own onCtaPress, so the two nest, a button in a button. Declared: Press handler for the whole card. When set, the card becomes pressable.

props.name: height
props.description: Card height in px. Defaults to `223` (Figma spec). Default 223, from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Modes object for design-token resolution. Cascaded to default children and to `badge` / `avatar` / `specialBadge` / `cta` / icon slots.

props.name: style
props.description: Style overrides for the card container.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label for the card. Defaults to `title`.

props.name: disableTruncation
props.description: When `true`, disables text truncation: the trailing ellipsis (`…`) is never shown and any `numberOfLines` clamp is ignored, so the text wraps to as many lines as it needs even when horizontal space is tight. Also forwarded to the default glass special badge (not the corner badge).

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: The card gives its corner badge and its Button AppearanceBrand Secondary unless modes set one: a lilac badge with a purple label, and a purple Button. Declared: A token collection ProductMerchandisingCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

gaps.text: At 328 px with both badges the header is 60 px and the footer 97, where Figma’s are 55 and 95, and the badges are 23 px against Figma’s 22 (Component Bug #356).
Figma binds a title font-weight token that the token file lacks; the code uses the body high weight token, also 700 (Component Bug #356).
Figma’s card has the booleans showBadge and showSpecialBadge; the package has neither and shows each badge only when you pass its label (Component Bug #356).
